candidates.statement: Effective Date: 12/30/2020, 04/15/2021, 11/17/2026 Page 3 of 7 • To the best of their knowledge, CDER and other FDA participants' perspectives during the meeting will be consistent with CDER and FDA policy. Their individual perspectives should not be treated as necessarily describing established policy.
candidates.context: 2 See reference 2 , Guidance for industry and FDA staff Qualification Process for Drug Development Tools (November 2020). • CPIM discussions and meeting summaries are nonbinding. RESPONSIBILITIES CPIM Project Manager (PM) • Notifies the CPIM Scientific Lead (SL) of CPIM requests.

candidates.statement: The package should include the following: o Agenda o Proposed Attendees o Objectives o Specific questions for the FDA to consider PROCEDURES Submission and evaluation of request for CPIM The Requester completes and submits the CPIM Request Form available on the CPIM web page. 3 , 4 This form is directed automatically to the email account
candidates.context: Requester • Submits the CPIM request form. • Submits the CPIM preparation package at least 4 weeks in advance of the CPIM. • The CPIM PM will confirm receipt of all CPIM requests. • Requests referred from other offices or divisions will be directed to the CPIM PM.

candidates.statement: Arranging a CPIM • The CPIM PM will request an information package from the Requester no later than 4 weeks prior to the CPIM.
candidates.context: The CPIM PM will connect the Requester to the appropriate centers/offices/divisions. • The information package should include a list of proposed attendees, an agenda, objectives, a presentation, any additional background information for the topic to be discussed, and specific questions for FDA to consider.

candidates.statement: Records Management All CPIM records — including request forms, meeting materials, summaries, and correspondences — must be retained in accordance with FDA records retention policies and National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) guidance.
candidates.context: • The final summary will be sent to the Requester. • Following the CPIM, the FDA website is updated with the meeting topic and date. File Code Records Description and Authorized Disposition NARA Approved Citation FDA-8510 Substantial Material.
